title: Module-complex representative on an affine scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $E$ be an object of $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. There exists an unbounded complex $M$ of $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] such that $E\cong Q((Y\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y))^*\widetilde M)$, where restriction is applied termwise. No K-flatness condition on $M$ and no scheme morphism other than the canonical chart occurs.

source.place: Tag 06Z0 (perfect-lemma-affine-compare-bounded), equivalence and essential surjectivity; canonical affine chart transport

proof.text: Define F as restriction along the inverse spectrum chart and G as restriction along the chart. The restriction composition, congruence, and identity isomorphisms give F followed by G isomorphic to the identity. Exact-functor localization transports this isomorphism to their derived functors.

The exact restriction homology comparison and preservation of quasi-coherent sheaves show F(E) has quasi-coherent cohomology. Apply the core affine derived equivalence to K=F(E), choose M representing its inverse image using essential surjectivity of Q, and compose the equivalence counit with its termwise tilde comparison.

Apply the derived G functor to this isomorphism. Compose on the left with the inverse of the F-G identity comparison and on the right with G.mapDerivedCategoryFactors. This yields the required representative.

theorem exists_affine_module_complex_representative (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y E) :
    ∃ M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, ⊤)) ℤ,
      Nonempty (E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).toRingedSpace) ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.toSpecΓ))
          (by change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.toSpecΓ).PreservesZeroMorphisms
              infer_instance) (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
              (@id (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(Y, ⊤) ⥤
                SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).toRingedSpace))
                (tilde.functor Γ(Y, ⊤))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)))
